notes: Text extraction rendered the 'ff'/'fi'/'fl' ligatures as single Unicode glyphs; they are written as plain letters. Many zone 12 names have no spaces in the printed PDF itself (checked against the rendered page), e.g. 'ThiruvalluvarNagar,ArumugamNagar', 'Nanganallur21ststreet'. They are kept as printed. Line-end hyphens were joined (e.g. 'GowriNagarand-/CRRPuram' becomes 'GowriNagarandCRRPuram', 'Lak-/shmi' becomes 'Lakshmi'); hyphens printed mid-line were kept ('Thiruvallu-var Nagar', 'Ba- laji nagar'). Source typos are kept (e.g. 'Grden', 'Laywer', 'steer', 'Evacution', 'submersable', 'Madhavapuran', 'Mamaganallur').

Heavy-rain table (p.653-654): the intro says 29 inundated spots but the table has 24 rows. Columns are location, reason and pumps used. There is no pump-location or disposal column, so pump_location and disposal_point are null. Reasons: rows for 156 and 157 (Madha Nagar ... River View Colony, 11 rows) are 'Overflow of Manapakkam Canal'; the 158 rows (Burma Colony, ThulasingaPuram, Ganapathipuram Colony, Wood Creek County, Vasantham Colony, Anna main road) are 'Adyar River water level increased so water cannot drain out'; 160 Laywer Jeganathan Street, 161 Sanjay Gandhi Street, 161 Murugan Street, 162 Thiruvalluvar Nagar and 167 Nanganallur 44th Street are 'Low lying area'; 165 Saraswathi nagar main road 5th to 8th is 'Veerangal Odai Over flow and Run of water from AGS Colony (Z-13)'; 167 Kanniga Colony is 'Lack of Drain in that location'. The Sanjay Gandhi Street pump is printed just '6.5' (no unit).
Mild-rain, moderate-rain and sewer-block stagnation tables are all printed 'NIL' (p.658), so water_stagnation is empty.

Relief centres (p.658-661): the intro says '11 relief centres to a total capacity of 1280', but the table has 9 rows with capacities summing to 2450. Several rows list multiple buildings in one cell (kept whole). The ward-157 row is printed only as '2.Community Hall'; the evacuation table (p.666) shows the ward-157 centre as '1.Corporation Middle School - M.G.Salai 2.Community Hall', so the Corporation Middle School, M.G.Salai seems to be missing from the relief table. The Drinking water / Toilets / Cooking columns are blank for every row except Community Hall & Gym Building (Yes / Yes / No), so they are null elsewhere. The relief-shelter map page (p.662) has a mirrored legend listing R1-R16 / S1-S20 that was not parsed.

Relief centre phones are printed split across lines (e.g. '94450 / 25956') and were re-joined. Ward 159's AE cell holds two numbers, '96773 40896/ 94451 90759', stored as 9677340896 and 9445190759. In ward 166, the Evacuation AE (9445190767) and the Relief Materials AE (9445190766) differ, as printed. The ARO number 9445190092 is the same for all centres (printed '944519 / 0092' in row 6).

Evacuation table (p.665-666): the relief-centre cell is merged across rows 1-2 (ward 156) and rows 3-4 (ward 157), and the year cell is merged for rows 3-4. The merged value is repeated on each row. The intro says 2150 people were evacuated; the rows sum to 2150. The table has no area/ward-name column, so area=null.

Water entered houses (p.664-665): the intro says 24 spots; the table has 12 rows, some listing several streets. Row 8 is printed with ward 168 (Erikarai Street), outside this zone's wards 156-167; kept as printed. The ward-157 and ward-158 rows have identical text ('KrishnaNagar,AmbedkarNagar,IndiraNagar').

Subways (p.663): the intro says four subways, but the table has five rows (including Kathipara Urban Square Underpass). Length and disposal point are not given. Maintained-by, total motors, motor breakdown and generator are packed into 'pumps'. The '8 HP - 1' line belongs to Pazhavanthangal's Tractor Motor list, which makes its total 8; this was checked against the printed totals (sum 44).
The NDRF Commandant phone is printed '04177 - 246594/246269'. The second number has no printed prefix and is given here as '04177-246269', assuming the shared STD code.
Parks (p.649): each ward row lists many parks/streets in one cell, kept whole as printed in name (location=null).
Pumping stations are not tied to wards (ward=null). The category column (HT3/LT3/LT2/Road Side) is not captured. The intro text says 'one pumping station ... 50 MLD' but 7 are listed.

There is no hospitals/UPHC table, no zonal office address, no lorries table and no narrow-streets table in this zone appendix. There are no TNSCB tenements in Alandur zone. Not captured (no schema field): canals and other water bodies (p.650, 652), SWD lengths (p.653). Pages 657 and 662 are map pages whose labels leaked into the text; they were ignored apart from the note above. zone_12.txt ends with an empty '##### PDF page 677' marker.
